title: In-House Evaluation Is Not Enough: Towards Robust Third-Party Flaw Disclosure for General-Purpose AI

bias_targets.methodology: The paper is a policy and framework proposal that does not conduct its own bias measurements. However, it uses a retrospective example of evaluating a BERT model with the HONEST framework (analyzing sentence completion tasks for negative social and professional stereotypes) to demonstrate how to use their proposed standardized AI flaw reporting system.
